registration: Fixed before first training/test execution; no parameter or test-based candidate tuning
split: Original 70/10/20 chronological split; exact per-horizon continuity and target masks
selection: Best epoch by validation masked MAE, all fixed candidates reported on test after training
features: Same 14 causal temporal/calendar/training-mean features as classical temporal context; one learned directional graph message layer; residual prediction from last observed speed
promotion: Research candidates only; retain evaluated classical graph-context model unless independent evidence supports replacement
